title: Quantitative light-particle limit for the Vlasov-Fokker-Planck-Navier-Stokes system
summary: We investigate the hydrodynamic limit of the Vlasov-Fokker-Planck-Navier-Stokes system in the light particle regime, where the particle relaxation takes place on a singularly fast time scale. Using a relative entropy method adapted to this scaling, we develop the first quantitative convergence theory for the light particle limit. Our analysis yields explicit rates for the convergence of both the kinetic distribution and the fluid velocity, extending the qualitative compactness-based result of Goudon, Jabin, and Vasseur [Indiana Univ.
